hardware: NVIDIA L4 (x86 EC2 host, x86_64), not Jetson
dataset: hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy clean/validation, first n_samples items (read speech, not robot commands)
latency_definition: wall-clock of model.transcribe + segment iteration on one clip, median over n_runs after warmup
note: command-domain accuracy not measured, no recorded robot commands

wer_caveat: WER uses langgrasp.language.stt.word_error_rate (word Levenshtein after lowercasing and punctuation stripping). LibriSpeech references spell out words ('MISTER') while Whisper writes 'Mr.', which counts as an error; the residual WER is dominated by this normalisation mismatch on 8 short read-speech clips, not by misrecognitions. It is not a command-domain number.
vram_note: single model resident at a time; small fp16 on CTranslate2 stays far below the 3 GB shared-GPU budget (not separately measured)
